text: He told me to send my credit card details and I sent it.
Someone called claiming to be from the bank and I ended up reading out my card number and expiry date to them before I realized something was wrong.
A man came to my desk saying he was from IT and needed my password to fix an issue, I gave it to him before checking his ID.
I told the caller my account PIN because he said it was urgent and sounded like he worked at the bank. I realize now it was probably a scam.
Somebody on the phone asked for the OTP that just came to my number and I read it out to them without thinking.
A woman called saying she was confirming a delivery and needed my card number to 'verify my address', I gave it to her before hanging up and feeling uneasy.
I shared my staff login with someone who called claiming to be from head office doing a system audit, only realized after the call that we don't do audits that way.
Somebody texted asking for my BVN to 'reactivate my account' and I sent it before thinking twice.
A caller convinced me he was my bank's fraud team and I gave him my account number and the code that came to my phone right after.
I gave out my ATM PIN over the phone to someone claiming to be verifying a transaction, only realized afterward that banks don't ask for PINs.
Someone called asking for my card details claiming to be from the bank, I refused and hung up.
A caller asked for my account PIN saying it was for verification, I told him banks don't ask for that and ended the call.
Somebody texted asking me to confirm my BVN for 'account reactivation', I did not respond and reported the number.
A person came to reception claiming to need a staff password for an urgent fix, security turned him away before he reached anyone.
Got a call asking me to read out an OTP for 'verification', I told them I wasn't comfortable and the line went dead immediately.
